name: io.github.BASIC-BIT/vbmatrix-mcp
title: VBMatrix MCP
description: MCP server for VB-Audio Matrix over VBAN-TEXT and Voicemeeter via helper process and VBAN-TEXT.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_HOST
environmentVariables.description: VBMatrix host or IP address.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_PORT
environmentVariables.description: VBAN UDP port used by VBMatrix.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_STREAM
environmentVariables.description: Incoming VBAN-TEXT command stream name.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Query response timeout in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow routing point write operations. Defaults to true; set false for read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOW_ALL_SUIDS
environmentVariables.description: Allow writes to all SUIDs when writes are enabled. Defaults to true; set false to require VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOWED_SUIDS.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOWED_SUIDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated SUID allowlist for write operations when VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOW_ALL_SUIDS=false, for example VASIO8,VAIO1.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Allow destructive/system operations such as engine restart. Defaults to true; set false to block them.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_DISABLE_RAW_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: Disable the advanced raw VBAN-TEXT escape hatch.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_PRESET_PATCH_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated absolute Windows roots allowed for Matrix preset patch file load/save-as.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_MCP_DISABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Disable typed Voicemeeter write tools.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_MCP_DISABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Disable Voicemeeter destructive actions such as device changes and MacroButtons mutation.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_MCP_DISABLE_RAW_REMOTE_API
environmentVariables.description: Disable the advanced raw Voicemeeter Remote API escape hatch.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_VBAN_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host or IP address for raw Voicemeeter VBAN-TEXT commands.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_VBAN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: UDP port for raw Voicemeeter VBAN-TEXT commands. Keep separate from VBMATRIX_PORT.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_VBAN_STREAM
environmentVariables.description: Incoming Voicemeeter VBAN-TEXT command stream name.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_VBAN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Query response timeout for raw Voicemeeter VBAN-TEXT commands in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_MCP_DISABLE_RAW_VBAN_TEXT
environmentVariables.description: Disable the advanced raw Voicemeeter VBAN-TEXT escape hatch.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_HELPER_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Optional custom Voicemeeter helper executable. If unset, the bundled Windows PowerShell helper is used when available.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_HELPER_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of base arguments for VOICEMEETER_HELPER_COMMAND.

environmentVariables.name: VOICEMEETER_REMOTE_DLL
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit path to VoicemeeterRemote64.dll or VoicemeeterRemote.dll for the bundled helper.

environmentVariables.name: VBMATRIX_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for stderr diagnostics.
